name: Maria Island Cruises
summary: Daily cruises from Triabunna in southern Tasmania to Ile des Phoques and along the coast of Maria Island. The boat goes into granite sea caves and past thousands of Australian fur seals, and guests then spend about two hours ashore on Maria Island. A Full Day Tour adds a bus trip from Hobart.
standouts: Sea caves at Ile des Phoques, including Rainbow Cave with its natural skylight
Guided walk through Darlington's World Heritage-listed convict settlement on Maria Island
Trips are not cancelled for low numbers, even for one guest

contact.address: Dock Head Building, Franklin Wharf, Hobart

trips.title: Cruise + Walk from Triabunna
trips.summary: A day cruise from Triabunna to Ile des Phoques and along the coast of Maria Island, with about two hours ashore. The boat goes into granite sea caves and past thousands of Australian fur seals, and dolphins and migrating whales may be seen. Ashore there is a guided walk through the Darlington convict settlement, then time to explore at your own pace.
highlights: Sea caves at Ile des Phoques, including Rainbow Cave with its natural skylight
Thousands of Australian fur seals at Ile des Phoques
About two hours ashore with a guided walk through Darlington's World Heritage-listed convict settlement
Alternative route along the Maria Island coast if weather stops the boat reaching Ile des Phoques

trips.requirements: No age or height restrictions. Guests need to arrive on time for the pre-cruise briefing and the walk from the Visitor Centre to the boat. Tell the operator about any dietary requirements.
trips.checkNotes: Both trips are tabs on the single home page; there are no separate trip pages. The tab is labelled 'Cruise + Walk from Triabunna' and the heading inside it says 'Cruise + Walk'. The page gives departure and return times but no stated duration; 345 minutes is worked out from 10:00am to about 3:45pm. Prices show a $ sign with no currency; AUD assumed. Booking: the Book Now button in this tab links to https://www.pennicottjourneys.com.au/book?journey=maria, the same Maria Island booking page used by the Full Day Tour; it is on a different domain and was not opened, so the booking system behind it is unknown. The itinerary lists check in 9:30am, cruise departs 10:00am, guided walk and exploration 1:15pm, depart Maria Island 3:15pm, back in Triabunna 3:45pm. The page does not say whether lunch is eaten on the island or on the boat, and gives no price for children under 3. The exact wharf the boat leaves from is not stated; the page says the boat is a walk from the Visitor Centre. The 'Operates' line says 'Daily from 15th Oct 2026', which is the date this page was read, so the start date may be generated by the page rather than a real season start.

trips.title: Full Day Tour from Hobart
trips.summary: A full day from Hobart that starts with a return guided bus trip to Triabunna, with morning tea on arrival. From Triabunna the boat leaves at 10:00am for Maria Island and Ile des Phoques, and guests then have lunch and a walk on the island. The group is back in Hobart at about 5:30pm.
highlights: Return guided bus tour from Hobart to Triabunna
Morning tea on arrival at Triabunna
Cruise to Maria Island and Ile des Phoques
Lunch and a walk on Maria Island, back in Hobart at about 5:30pm

checkNotes: IDENTITY, PLEASE CHECK FIRST: the address on our list, eastcoastcruises.com.au (and www.), answers every path with a permanent redirect to www.mariaislandcruises.com.au. That site is branded Maria Island Cruises and is run under the name Pennicott Wilderness Journeys. Everything here was read from that site, and the name is recorded as Maria Island Cruises. A person should confirm it is the same business as East Coast Cruises before this page is published. The site is one page (its sitemap lists only the home page), so no trip has its own page or its own photos. Pages not read, to stay on the operator's own site: pennicottjourneys.com.au (about, awards, FAQs, boats, accessibility, gift cards, contact and the Book Now page) and pwj.com.au/terms, so no awards or accreditation claims are captured. The menu also links other Pennicott journeys on their own sites (Bruny Island Cruises, Bruny Island Traveller, Cape Raoul Cruises, Fluted Cape Walk, Freycinet Aqua Express, Iron Pot Cruises, Port Arthur Bus, Seafood Seduction, Tasman Island Cruises, Three Capes Track, Wineglass Bay Cruises); none are included. Gift Cards appear only as a menu link, so no voucher terms are captured. No Rezdy or FareHarbor links appear on the page, so rezdyAlias is null; both Book Now buttons go to https://www.pennicottjourneys.com.au/book?journey=maria. Contact: the phone, email and Hobart address are the Pennicott head office details in the page footer; the page shows the phone as (03) 6234 4270 and hides the email behind a protected link, which resolves to the address given. Cruise guests check in at the Triabunna booking centre, 21 Vicary Street. Cancellation terms on the page: the operator may charge the full fare for cancellations within 24 hours of departure and half within 48 hours, and bookings made through third parties follow that party's own terms. The operator may cancel or vary any trip, and in extremely bad weather offers a full refund or an alternative date; if weather stops the boat reaching Ile des Phoques it runs an alternative route along the Maria Island coast. Site claims kept out of copy: the sea caves described as Tasmania's largest granite sea caves, the fossils dated to about 300 million years, and the peak height of Bishop and Clerk.
